title: Two root-state header guards have no test that can reach them
outcome: Two root-state header guards have no test that can reach them
acceptance: A fault-injection test drives a projection-only scalar drift and asserts the exact reason 'header differs from canonical head'
A fault-injection test drives an extra or renamed header field and asserts the exact reason 'unexpected header fields'

completion.summary: Fault-injection tests reach both header guards: scalar column drift refuses the exact reason header differs from canonical head; extra header field refuses unexpected header fields; each fails when its guard is removed. Refused reads write nothing.
